rationale: Final Gate A decision payload prepared after Mika's revision 6 findings-focused PASS. It preserves the exact-bound v4 artifacts as historical failure evidence and binds the passing v5 replacement input/capability manifest and finite-coverage report. Authenticated GitHub comments 5566509712 and 5566572994 ratify the outcome-independent ESM1v_single alias/direction, bind the migration receipt to the accepted Issue #11 terminal inventory, bound the completed summary-only attempt, and conditionally approve main, aggregate-only reproduction and terminal archive resources/operations. The replacement exact-checks all four allowed summary/processing-manifest pairs without opening a raw-score data row or truth file. This final payload does not become an effective Gate A until both authorities publish fresh comments containing its exact marker and all four major boundaries, their authenticated envelopes replace the pending placeholders, manifest_status becomes authorized, and the production contract Check passes.
